custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lower two rectangular windows. In real barometers, these usually house thermometers and hygrometers with clear scales and fluids/needles. AI often fails to render these small, complex internal details, resulting in 'melted' or nonsensical brass blobs. Also, scrutinize the dial text for subtle character deformations that might look like blur at first glance.

The dial face is white with black text reading 'BAROMETER' and numerical markings. Below the dial are two vertical rectangular windows containing brass mechanisms (likely thermometers or hygrometers). The casing is polished wood, mounted on a textured, cream-colored wall.
